svg.title: Blue, Yellow and Red
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Actual support is a leaning parallelogram, with three equal strips. Observed bounding aspect retained; published short-edge width cannot establish physical bounding width.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://buffaloakg.org/artworks/k19693-blue-yellow-and-red; source object K1969:3; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
